note: Per-million-token USD rates for Gemini, Claude, and GPT models reachable from ADK agents (native Gemini backend, plus Claude/GPT via ADK's LiteLlm integration -- see google-adk's models/lite_llm.py). Historically Gemini-only (hence the filename/loader name -- kept for now, see _pricing.py's module docstring); Phase 2 W3 added Claude and current-generation GPT entries plus a zero-cost entry for local/self-hosted models (Phase 3 B1: local-model zero-cost pricing now requires the caller to opt in via ADK_TRACEGAUGE_ASSUME_LOCAL -- see the __local_zero_cost__ entry's own note and _pricing.py's module docstring for why: Ollama Cloud, a real paid product, shares the identical ollama_chat//ollama/ LiteLlm prefix as local Ollama). Prices change without notice -- verify against each entry's source_url before relying on a number for a real budget decision. Standard (interactive/online) tier only -- no Batch API pricing (ADK's live-agent plugin path never issues Batch API calls, confirmed by source grep of google-adk's models/plugins modules; a batch call is a separate async job-submission API that never flows through BasePlugin.after_model_callback). Text/image/video input rate only -- several vendors price audio input separately (typically higher); audio input tokens are NOT priced from this table: the adapter removes them from the priced tokens and flags them as unpriced, so an audio-heavy invocation is reported incomplete rather than under-charged at the text rate. schema_version 2 added optional per-model long-context tiering (see 'long_context_threshold_tokens'/'long_context_model_key') -- verified P0 fix, Phase 2 W1. schema_version 3 adds optional 'promo_until' (ISO date) + 'standard_rate' ({input_usd_per_mtok, output_usd_per_mtok}) for time-limited promotional entries -- see _pricing.py's resolve_model/effective_prices, which automatically switch a promotional entry to its standard_rate once promo_until has passed, no manual table edit required (Phase 3 B2). schema_version 4 (0.10.0) adds optional per-entry 'cached_input_usd_per_mtok' (verified against the vendor page; wins over the global cache_multipliers.read). 'deprecation' {shutdown_on, replacement, source_url, checked_on} records a vendor shutdown date. 'audio_input_usd_per_mtok'/'audio_cached_input_usd_per_mtok' (audio is priced only for entries that publish BOTH). 'grounding.google_search' (per grounded prompt on Gemini 2.5; per query on 3.x, which the adapter does not price).

cache_multipliers._note: Fallback only. Since schema_version 4 every entry in the bundled table carries its own verified 'cached_input_usd_per_mtok', which wins over this multiplier; the multiplier applies solely to custom tables that omit it. Write multipliers are 0: ADK's plugin path never surfaces a cache-write token count.

input_modality_verification.result: No entry prices image or video input apart from text input. Read from the RAW vendor pages (curl, not a summarizing tool). Where a Gemini page labels the modalities, image and video share the text rate (only audio differs, and audio is flagged unpriced); where it lists one input price, no per-modality rate is listed. No table model lists a separate video-input rate. For Claude and GPT the vendor docs bill image tokens at the model's input price. Re-checked for Gemini every week: scripts/check_price_table_vs_vendor.py reports MISMATCH if an input row ever prices image or video apart from text.
